## Context
PayPal's document requests and dispute reviewers read PDFs. A fixed, hash-identified **scope snapshot** turns the agreed scope (plus the client's acknowledgement, if any) into one file the seller can attach. PayPal's own "Why Immutable PDFs Matter" post supports fixed agreement documents. B6 #9 renamed it: it is a **"scope snapshot", never "signed"**, because it is seller text plus an optional buyer acknowledgement, not a signature. Pillar P1 → **Innovation** (proof built at payment time, reused for holds, disputes and document requests).

## Scope
- Worker job `render_scope_snapshot(pack_id)` with `@react-pdf/renderer`, triggered by the seller ("Create scope snapshot") or by `evidence.added` of kind `client_ack`. Content:
  - Title "Scope snapshot", with Cleared as the generator
  - Payment: capture id, amount, currency, date
  - The scope text verbatim, with its evidence sha256
  - Delivery evidence list (kind, created_at, sha256): metadata only
  - The client acknowledgement block if present (typed name, accepted_at UTC + seller tz, IP, user agent, and the `client_ack` item sha256); otherwise "Not acknowledged by the client"
  - generated_at
  - Footer: "Generated by Cleared from seller-provided text and recorded acknowledgements. This is not a signature or a contract."
- It is deterministic: fixed PDF metadata (creation date = generated_at, a fixed producer), so the same inputs give the same bytes and sha256.
- Fonts: an embedded Noto Sans + Noto Sans Devanagari (OFL), so HI text renders. Fonts are committed under `apps/worker/assets/fonts/` with their licence.
- Output: a blob (BlobStore) plus an immutable `evidence_items` row, kind `scope_snapshot`, with its sha256. It is written in one transaction with an `evidence.added` outbox row, and is idempotent on (pack_id, input hash).
- It must be under 10 MB and a valid PDF (PayPal evidence limits), so it can be selected by the M2-07 dispute draft.
- Seller UI: a download button on the proof pack. The file is served with `Content-Disposition: attachment`, workspace-scoped.

## Out of scope
- The acknowledgement link: M3-06
- Compiling the dispute evidence PDF: M2-07 (it consumes this file)
- Hindi UI copy review: M4-03

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Rendering the same fixture pack twice gives an identical sha256 (test)
- [ ] The PDF parses (pdf-lib load), is under 10 MB, and its text contains the scope text verbatim and "This is not a signature or a contract"
- [ ] The words "signed" and "signature" appear only in the negating footer (text-extraction test)
- [ ] With a `client_ack` present, the acknowledgement block shows accepted_at and the ack sha256; without one it shows "Not acknowledged by the client"
- [ ] A Devanagari scope text fixture renders, with no missing-glyph boxes (text extraction round-trips)
- [ ] Downloading from another workspace returns 404 (integration test)
- [ ] The evidence item and outbox row are written in one transaction (forced-failure test)

## Deliverables
- `apps/worker/src/jobs/render-scope-snapshot.tsx` (+ tests, incl. `scope-snapshot.artifact.test.ts` that writes the fixture PDF to the temp dir)
- `apps/worker/assets/fonts/{NotoSans-Regular.ttf,NotoSansDevanagari-Regular.ttf,OFL.txt}`
- `apps/web/app/api/packs/[id]/scope-snapshot/route.ts`, `apps/web/components/proof/scope-snapshot-button.tsx`
- `fixtures/packs/scope-snapshot-*.json`

## Validation Gate
```bash
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
pnpm --filter ./apps/worker test -- scope-snapshot
pnpm --filter ./apps/worker test -- scope-snapshot.artifact   # writes os.tmpdir()/m3-07.pdf (honours $TMPDIR)
ls -l "$TMPDIR/m3-07.pdf" && shasum -a 256 "$TMPDIR/m3-07.pdf"
pnpm --filter ./apps/web test -- scope-snapshot
./scripts/landing-checks.sh --fast
```

## Handoff
- M2-07's dispute draft can select the `scope_snapshot` evidence
- M3-11 downloads it in the storyboard
- M5-01 explains why it is "snapshot", not "signed"
